_comment: Group-level combat policy presets for fleet hierarchy. Each axis is independent.

focus_strongest.name: Focus Strongest
focus_strongest.description: Group coordinates fire on the strongest enemy in range.

focus_nearest.name: Focus Nearest
focus_nearest.description: Group coordinates fire on the nearest enemy.

focus_weakest.name: Focus Weakest
focus_weakest.description: Group coordinates fire on the most damaged enemy.

distributed.name: Distributed
distributed.description: Each ship picks its own target independently.

anti_fighter.name: Anti-Fighter
anti_fighter.description: Prioritize fighters, missiles, and small craft.

opportunistic.name: Opportunistic
opportunistic.description: Target whatever each ship can hit most effectively.

advance.name: Advance
advance.description: Move toward enemy, close distance aggressively.

hold_position.name: Hold Position
hold_position.description: Stay near deployment/anchor position, don't chase.

pursue.name: Pursue
pursue.description: Chase fleeing or distant enemies at full speed.

hit_and_run.name: Hit and Run
hit_and_run.description: Attack run cycles — approach, fire, retreat, repeat.

group_25.name: Group 25%
group_25.description: Group retreats when aggregate HP drops below 25%.

group_50.name: Group 50%
group_50.description: Group retreats when aggregate HP drops below 50%.

individual_15.name: Individual 15%
individual_15.description: Each ship retreats independently at 15% HP.

individual_30.name: Individual 30%
individual_30.description: Each ship retreats independently at 30% HP.

flagship_lost.name: Flagship Lost
flagship_lost.description: Group retreats if flagship is destroyed with no successor.

ammo_depleted.name: Ammo Depleted
ammo_depleted.description: Retreat when primary weapons are exhausted.
